featIpDesc: See which ports and services are reachable from the internet, and which known CVEs match. We scan from outside, we do not log into your server.
featDomainDesc: Check DNS records, TLS certificate, security headers, and tech stack. A posture snapshot, not a business-logic pentest.
featMobileDesc: Upload an APK, AAB, or IPA. We flag risky permissions, exported components, and hardcoded secrets in the binary.
featAttachDesc: Schedule scans on a recurring basis and compare each run to the last. One-off nmap is not a control; a schedule is.
featWorkspaceDesc: Give your team shared access to scan history and reports. Credits stay on each person's login, not a shared pool.
featAssetsDesc: Name your IPs, domains, and apps so everyone talks about the same thing. Hard caps per plan keep the list honest.
featGuardDesc: One lightweight agent per VM reports machine inventory and fires critical alerts. This is not a full SIEM dashboard.
featUptimeDesc: Check whether your site or port still answers from the outside. It is a reachability probe, not a vulnerability scan or an SLA guarantee.
featCreditsDesc: A per-scan wallet on your account. We do not publish rupiah prices on this page.

heroHeadline: Find internet-facing exposure, schedule it, then alarm on the box — without inventing malware.
heroProduct: Security attach for colo, VPS, and hospitality stacks
heroSub: You already pay for the rack or VPS. Sinexis adds scheduled exposure checks from the internet and a thin runtime signal on the box. Periodic scan is not 24/7 SIEM. Host Protect reads disk on your VM through a helper, it does not fabricate findings. One wazuh-agent per machine. Not a human pentest.

notFoundBody: That URL is not a Sinexis page. Go home or sign in to the dashboard.
stepScanDesc: Pick an IP, domain, or mobile app. We scan from the outside and give you an HTML report.
stepAttachDesc: Set a schedule so the scan runs again next week or next month. Each run compares to the previous one so you can see what changed.
stepWorkspaceDesc: Invite your team. Everyone sees the same scan trail instead of emailing PDFs around.
stepGuardDesc: Install one agent on the VM. It reports what is running and fires critical alerts. SIEM Cases are separate incident tickets, turned off by default.
siemNote: SIEM search and Cases (incident tickets) are behind an ops flag. They are not sold as a live feature on this page.
faqAuthQ: Do I need permission to scan?
faqAuthA: Yes. Only scan hosts and apps you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Unauthorized scanning is not allowed.
faqPentestA: No. This is automated outside-in scanning that checks your posture from the internet. It does not replace a manual pentest for business logic. Keep an annual pentest if your contract or compliance requires one.
faqDataA: Results stay in your workspace. See the privacy policy for details. Do not upload secrets or credentials you cannot store safely.
faqGuardQ: Guard vs SIEM vs Host Protect?
faqGuardA: Guard is a lightweight agent that reports machine inventory and critical alerts. SIEM is log search plus incident tickets (Cases), turned off by default. Host Protect reads files on your VM through a helper script to find web malware. If the helper is not installed, we wait. We do not invent findings.
faqAgentA: No. One wazuh-agent per VM. Host Protect is a helper script on the same machine, not a second enrollment daemon.
